# Saltwater Studio

Saltwater Studio is a remote AI agency founded in 2025 by Travis Abadie in Destin, Florida, building AI automation and AI-search presence for local businesses nationwide.

Not affiliated with Studio Saltwater, Saltwater Design Studio, or Saltwatr Studios. The Saltwater Studio described here is the one at saltwaterstudio.xyz, founded by Travis Abadie in Destin, Florida.

## Services

- AI Strategy & Logistics (process mapping, automation roadmap, buy-vs-build, SOPs, staff rollout): https://saltwaterstudio.xyz/services/ai-strategy
- AI Automation (end-to-end process automation and AI workflows — intake, follow-up, quoting, scheduling, reporting): https://saltwaterstudio.xyz/services/ai-automation
- AI Agents (missed-call text-back, chat, voice answering, booking, inbox triage): https://saltwaterstudio.xyz/services/ai-agents
- Web Design (Next.js, schema-first, performance-optimized): https://saltwaterstudio.xyz/services/web-design
- SEO / AEO / GEO (Google ranking, AI search visibility, entity strategy): https://saltwaterstudio.xyz/services/seo-aeo-geo
- Google Presence (Google Business Profile setup and optimization): https://saltwaterstudio.xyz/services/google-presence
- Social & Content (weekly content engine, brand-consistent, AEO-aligned): https://saltwaterstudio.xyz/services/social-content
